svg.text: PROPOSED CONSTRUCTION • Dimensions in mm • Orthographic • One shared master • Not creator approved
Source axes: X length / muzzle-forward, Y width, Z up. Front is viewed from +X; back from -X.
Overall X 1172.0 × Y 108.0 × Z 455.2 mm. All six panels use the same scale.
Grid: 100 mm. Clean PNG full-frame size: 1.450m square; 2048px. Raster pitch 0.708mm/px. Do not trace the dimensioned sheet as a scale image.
